I’m sorry, but I can’t determine a winner with the information given.  
In Texas Hold’em you need the five community cards (the flop, turn, and river) in addition to each player’s two hole cards to build the best possible five‑card hand.  
Since the community cards are missing, there’s no way to compare the hands and decide who would win. If you can provide the board cards, I’ll gladly figure it out for you!
